events.name: action.ran
events.description: An action finished running — triggered by its log event or run by a scheduler task — successfully or not. `logTail` is the end of what it printed, where an error shows up.

events.name: log.base_detected
events.description: Fires when a player's base is detected on the map.

events.name: log.placement
events.description: Fires when a player places an item or object in the world.

events.name: log.player_bled_out
events.description: Fires when a player bleeds out and dies.

events.name: log.player_build_base
events.description: Fires when a player builds a base part.

events.name: log.player_cleared_rubble
events.description: Fires when a player clears rubble off a ruined map building.

events.name: log.player_committed_suicide
events.description: Fires when a player commits suicide.

events.name: log.player_connected
events.description: Fires when a player connects to the server.

events.name: log.player_destroyed_base
events.description: Fires when a player destroys a whole base structure at once, for example a fence with a chainsaw.

events.name: log.player_died
events.description: Fires when a player dies.

events.name: log.player_disconnected
events.description: Fires when a player disconnects from the server.

events.name: log.player_disconnecting_unconscious
events.description: Fires when a player disconnects while unconscious.

events.name: log.player_dismantled_base
events.description: Fires when a player dismantles a base part.

events.name: log.player_dismantled_building
events.description: Fires when a player dismantles a rebuilt part of a map building, such as a wooden door or window.

events.name: log.player_drowned
events.description: Fires when a player drowns.

events.name: log.player_folded_item
events.description: Fires when a player folds up an item.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_animal
events.description: Fires when a player is hurt by an animal — a wolf, a bear or a dog.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_barbed_wire
events.description: Fires when a player is hit by barbed wire.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_environment
events.description: Fires when a player is hurt by the environment.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_explosion
events.description: Fires when a player is hit by an explosion.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_fall
events.description: Fires when a player takes fall damage.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_fire
events.description: Fires when a player is hurt by fire.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_infected
events.description: Fires when a player is hurt by an infected.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_player
events.description: Fires when a player is hit by another player (without dying). `flags.friendly_fire` is true when both are in the same faction.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_trap
events.description: Fires when a player steps into a trap, such as a bear trap. Tripwires have their own event.

events.name: log.player_hit_by_vehicle
events.description: Fires when a player is hit by a vehicle.

events.name: log.player_hit_player
events.description: Fires when a player hits another player (without killing them). `flags.friendly_fire` is true when both are in the same faction.

events.name: log.player_identification
events.description: Fires when a player's device is identified on connection.

events.name: log.player_kill
events.description: Fires when a player kills another player. `flags` tells what made the kill special: headshot, revenge, trade, multi_kill (2, 3 or 4+ kills by the killer within 45 s, nil for a single kill), team_kill, alliance_violation (killer and victim belong to allied factions) and spawn_kill.

events.name: log.player_killed
events.description: Fires when a player is killed by another player, from the victim's perspective. `flags` carries the same kill context as player_kill.

events.name: log.player_killed_by_environment
events.description: Fires when a player is killed by the environment.

events.name: log.player_killed_by_infected
events.description: Fires when a player is killed by an infected.

events.name: log.player_login_info
events.description: Fires when a player logs in, with their place in the login queue, whether they had queue priority and, on Xbox servers, whether they play on a console or a Windows PC (`desktop`).

events.name: log.player_lowered_flag
events.description: Fires when a player lowers a territory flag.

events.name: log.player_online
events.description: Fires periodically while a player is online to report their presence.

events.name: log.player_packed_item
events.description: Fires when a player packs an item using a tool.

events.name: log.player_performed_emote
events.description: Fires when a player performs an emote.

events.name: log.player_raised_flag
events.description: Fires when a player raises a territory flag.

events.name: log.player_ran_into_tripwire
events.description: Fires when a player runs into a tripwire trap.

events.name: log.player_rebuilt_building
events.description: Fires when a player rebuilds part of a ruined map building: a wall, door, window, roof, ladder or well. Clearing rubble is player_cleared_rubble.

events.name: log.player_regained_consciousness
events.description: Fires when a player regains consciousness.

events.name: log.player_repaired_base
events.description: Fires when a player repairs a base structure.

events.name: log.player_respawn
events.description: Fires when a player respawns.

events.name: log.player_stash
events.description: Fires when a player stores or retrieves an item from a stash.

events.name: log.player_teleported
events.description: Fires when a player is teleported.

events.name: log.player_unconscious
events.description: Fires when a player falls unconscious.

events.name: log.subscription_spawn_failed
events.description: Fires when the game server could not spawn a player's or faction's shop subscription — usually because the chosen spot is blocked. Any charge for that restart is refunded automatically.

events.name: order.canceled
events.description: A shop order was canceled before delivery and its price refunded.

events.name: order.created
events.description: A shop order was placed — by a player, given by the support team, or as a redelivery of an earlier order (`order.redeliveryOfOrderId`). It is delivered with a later server restart.

events.name: order.delivered
events.description: A shop order was written to the server and will spawn with this restart.

events.name: order.delivery_reverted
events.description: A delivered shop order was taken back: the restart that should have spawned it failed, so it waits for the next one.

events.name: order.refunded
events.description: A shop order was refunded completely. A canceled order is refunded too but fires order.canceled instead.

events.name: review.opened
events.description: A support review (multi_account, fresh_account, account_sharing, device_switch) was opened, or reopened by a new member or incident (`entryType` opened / reopened). `members` are the organization players it is about.

events.name: review.resolved
events.description: A support review was decided; `noteExcerpt` is the start of the decision note.

events.name: ticket.created
events.description: A ticket was opened — by a player, by the support team (`byModerator`), by an action or by the companion.

events.name: ticket.message_added
events.description: Somebody wrote in a ticket — a player, the support team (`byModerator`) or an internal note (`internal`), on the web or in Discord. The opening message is part of ticket.created instead.

events.name: ticket.status_changed
events.description: A ticket changed status (open, in_progress, closed, archived) — by hand, or to in_progress when the support team first answers. Closing with auto-archive on fires twice: closed, then archived.

events.name: transaction.created
events.description: Money moved in a player wallet (`transaction.amount` is negative when it was taken). `player` owns the wallet, `origin` is who it moved on — they differ only for an alt account whose money goes to its main.
